facts.conditions: D3 is the catch/freewheeling diode on the -13.5V LM2596S-ADJ inverting buck-boost rail (board-b dc-dc-conversion stage). Unlike D1/D2 on the non-inverting +13.5V/+7.5V buck rails, whose catch diode blocks only Vin during switch-off, D3's inverting topology reverses the blocking-voltage reference so it blocks Vin + |Vout| = 15V (project PD-negotiated input) + 13.5V (project intermediate rail target) = 28.5V during switch-off. Calculated margin = fact-ss34-vrrm (40V) minus 28.5V stress.
facts.locator: Calculated from fact-ss34-vrrm and the project's LM2596S-ADJ inverting buck-boost topology for the -13.5V rail (dc-dc-conversion.kicad_sch D3 placement; architecture per CLAUDE.md DC-DC Stage description: '+15V -> -13.5V (LM2596S-ADJ in inverting buck-boost configuration)')
